meta.disclaimer: Verify against current ZRA guidance and Practice Notes before filing. Rates and thresholds change with each national budget.

calculation_modes.excess_only: Rate applies only to turnover ABOVE nil_band_upper (2026 Budget treatment: 0% on first K30,000, 5% on K30,001 to K5,000,000).
calculation_modes.total_turnover: Rate applies to the ENTIRE turnover once turnover exceeds nil_band_upper (flat 5% of gross turnover, no nil band relief).

eligibility.note: Voluntary VAT registration does not by itself exclude turnover tax under current ZRA guidance. Other eligibility exclusions still apply.

turnover_tax.above_ceiling_regime: Income tax (company/individual) applies when annual turnover exceeds the ceiling
turnover_tax.excluded_activities_note: Certain professional/consultancy services are excluded by statute from turnover tax and taxed under income tax.

vat.quarterly_threshold_note: Sources differ: some treat K200,000 in any 3 months as triggering mandatory registration; ZRA brochure places it under voluntary registration. Treated here as a warning trigger.
vat.overlap_note: ZRA guidance allows voluntary VAT registrants to file turnover tax; VAT and income tax regimes are separate obligations. Confirm eligibility.

income_tax.note: MAT is a separate turnover floor and may be creditable against income tax under the applicable law; eligibility and computation require Finance review.
